detail.longDescription: As AI moves into more sovereign environments, organisations need more than control over where it runs. They also need visibility into how it operates. This article explores how AWS European Sovereign Cloud and ARIS can work together to give enterprises the infrastructure and process context needed for governed, operational AI. Read the full article: https://www. techfinitive.com/features/how- aris-gives-sovereign-ai-a-map-of-how-the-business-works/ # AgenticAI # AI # AWS # Europe # Governance
